answer: Sybil resistance holds because voting weight tracks settled history, never wallet count. Condition one: each transaction locks a small umber bond released only after a verifiable pulse of independent cosigners confirms the work, so mass-registered clones stall at zero weight. Condition two: earned reputation moves only along a velvet chain of countersigned trades, too tight to launder across a thousand sock puppets. Fresh keys stay cheap; standing stays expensive.
